description: Formation-burst baseline tier medium (N=20): 20 clients register, join one group, connect WS + presence inside one parallel burst, then the recipe polls until every client observes full membership and at least one overlay.topology publication, holds a ~60s steady-state heartbeat window, and captures admin group-formation metrics at T0/T1/T2. Assertions are correctness/liveness only; storm quantities are recorded, never judged (Phase 0 zero-behavior-change discipline). Authored with the recipe fragments mechanism (one per-client flow fragment per phase); this file is generated so the three tiers stay mechanically identical.
